deathwatch.title: Death Watch
deathwatch.subtitle: Death detection & auto playback
deathwatch.langpackHint: First enable downloads the OCR language pack (~20MB), then works offline
deathwatch.selectMediaDesc: Supports mp4 / webm / mov video, mp3 / wav / ogg / m4a / flac audio. Add several files — one is played at random on each death
deathwatch.playDurationHint: 0 = play until the end; playback stops as soon as the time is reached
deathwatch.testOcrHint: Grabs one frame from the current screen for OCR, useful for tuning keywords
deathwatch.fullscreenHint: Note: fullscreen overlay requires the game to run in "Windowed Fullscreen" mode
deathwatch.pveHint: Note: regular PvE death screens may lack text; add keywords if detection misses
